instructions: This directory contains React components for the conversational interface.
- Use TypeScript interfaces for all props and component state
- Implement proper React patterns with hooks (useState, useEffect, etc.)
- Use Tailwind CSS classes following the existing design system
- Components should be functional components with proper JSX return types
- Use proper event handlers and form validation
- Implement loading states and error handling for async operations
- Follow accessibility best practices with proper ARIA attributes
- Use the shadcn/ui component library patterns for consistent styling
- Use descriptive component and prop names
- Implement proper TypeScript typing for OpenAI API data structures
- Use React.memo for performance optimization when appropriate
- Follow the existing patterns for message rendering and tool call display
